== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sages represent a significant stage of [[advancement]] in power, following the rank of [[Archlord]]. They achieve this status by establishing a connection to an [[Icon]], which is a symbol representing a greater concept of reality. This process requires intense willpower training and a deep understanding of one's [[madra]] to manifest the [[Icon]]. While [[Heralds]] focus their power inwardly to enhance themselves, Sages focus their willpower externally to directly influence and change the world around them. This external focus makes them more vulnerable than [[Heralds]], though Sages use various methods to compensate for this weakness. Sages are often characterized by an internal sense of great age, even if they appear young. Many Sages use titles derived from their [[Icons]] rather than their names, such as the [[Winter Sage]] or the [[Frozen Blade|Sage of the Frozen Blade]]. Because they embody specific concepts, Sages typically do not take apprentices, as those they train may only become weak imitations of themselves. As they grow in power, their spirits and bodies can eventually become too immense for their world to contain, necessitating an escape to a different realm. Sages hold significant [[Authority|authority]] and responsibility, often acting as protectors or high-ranking figures within clans, though they are sometimes viewed with skepticism if they lack traditional experience or clan connections.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|These powerful entities embody specific concepts and act as peers to [[Eithan]]. They have been known to question individuals like [[Yerin]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Sages were engaged in questioning [[Yerin]]. Additionally, they are considered peers to [[Eithan]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sages learn to control miracles and focus their willpower outside of themselves to directly alter the world. They are capable beings who can potentially assist in fighting against [[Dreadgods]].}}
